findings.title: Yield and reciprocal due
findings.claim: Within the declared pericope, the fully yielding gardens make the focus owner's relation to due readable as a reversal: the garden gives its material due, while the owner withholds truthful acknowledgment from his own self.
findings.mechanism: The garden and negated withholding in 18:33 are placed immediately before the focus's withholding predicate and self reference, so the contextual direction of giving and withholding changes who occupies the failed side of the relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase about wronging himself becomes a concrete reversal of reciprocity: the productive property is not the party that falls short; the owner's claim deprives the self that must recognize its dependence.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that the owner wrongs himself; this finding records an attributed contextual contrast between material yield and human acknowledgment, not moral agency for the garden or a claim that the 18:33 verb has only an ethical sense.

epistemic.reason: The exact ayahs, word indices, focus return, and branch records are supplied, while the reversal is an attributed HFT inference and the packet preserves a quantitative-shortfall alternative.

findings.claim: The focus prediction opens into a two-branch no-loss hedge: the garden is imagined as protected from ending, while any imagined return is also expected to end in something better.
findings.mechanism: The focus's permanence term is followed immediately by the same speaker's uncertain judgment, denial of the Hour, conditional return, expected benefit, and favorable turning point; the two possible futures insure the same confidence from opposite directions.
findings.reader_payoff: The statement becomes more than a prediction about one garden: it exposes a worldview that keeps loss outside the frame both by denying an ending and by promising advantage inside any ending.
findings.containment: The focus still plainly reports the speaker's claim about the garden; the hedge is an attributed contextual extension of that claim, with the packet preserving an alternative reading of the sequence as escalating inconsistency rather than conscious integration.

epistemic.reason: The immediate continuation and every traced word coordinate are supplied, but the insurance-like relation between the two claims is an attributed HFT inference.

findings.title: Perishing as dependency cascade
findings.claim: The focus denial of perishing is later unpacked as the vulnerability of a dependency stack: footing can lose grip, water can leave reach, enclosure can overwhelm, expenditure can become irrecoverable, and elevated supports can fall.
findings.mechanism: The focus verb naming disappearance is contacted in order by the slippery ground, inaccessible water, encompassing ruin, stranded expenditure, collapsed state, and fallen trellises supplied in 18:40-18:42.
findings.reader_payoff: The demonstrative 'this' can be heard as referring to an entire productive system rather than to one undifferentiated object, so loss becomes a sequence of ordinary supports ceasing to hold, flow, repay, and stand.
findings.containment: The primary reading remains the owner's denial that the garden will perish. The systems arrow is an attributed contextual synthesis of the ordered failures; the packet preserves the alternative that these may be independent calamity images.

epistemic.reason: The exact ordered context occurrences and focus return are supplied, while the causal systems relation among them is an attributed HFT inference.
